items.stimulus: רָאָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהִנֵּה טוֹב מְאֹד
options: I have kept thy statutes with all my heart.
God saw all that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.
Thou hast not kept my covenant.
items.answer: God saw all that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §20 A 11; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)
source.note: Transcribed by hand from the scans and checked against the Key.

items.stimulus: וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכָּל־הָעָם
options: There was no man of the Israelites goodlier than he: from his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
The day of death is better than the day of one's birth.
Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling-places of Jacob.
items.answer: There was no man of the Israelites goodlier than he: from his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §47 A 5; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)
source.note: Transcribed by hand from the scans and checked against the Key.
